title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Me and one of my good friends who works at Channel 4 are pretty much experts in this line of work
In rating female TV personalities, especially local
And I just wanted to circle back on this: Are you still in the category that Brooke Fletcher is not an easy 10 who one day is going to be a No. 1 contender in all the land?
That sounded so fucking creepy lmao
Contender in the Detroit area or among all sports
Right now, she’s easily no. 1 in Detroit
But one day she’s going to get a network gig and be contending for #1 overall
1) She’s not a natural reporter, and if she was really good she’d already be somewhere different 2) She’s hot, but Lauren Barra, who used to work here, was hotter.
I disagree but I won’t kill you for it
I just remember you were kinda low on my Brooke assesments
I still am by default because I don’t think she’s the most beautiful human being ever
She’s not
Ellen is
Degeneres? Agreed
At the risk of you having a relative named similarly
What an ugly-ass name
ELLEN
I’m gonna have a kid and name it Ellen, just so you have to be respectful every time your friend talks about it
Lol
I chuckled
Imagining the soulmates having a kid named Ellen
How’s that going by the way
Wait, are same and i soulmates in that joke or someone else?
If Sam’s your soulmate, sure
She’s not lol
Things are fine though. What have you done in Malta this weekend?
Bombed a couple tweets
You did?
Which ones?
